# What’s New in TimeVault 1.0.5
- The app icon now aligns with the new Time Machine icon introduced in macOS 27. - Custom-named Time Machine destinations are recognized from their configured mount points instead of relying on a literal volume name. - Approved backup-volume access and security-scoped bookmarks are revalidated more reliably when the app launches or volumes change. - Navigation, settings, and snapshot selection are locked while discovery or comparison work is running, while comparison cancellation remains available. - Comparison progress becomes determinate once TimeVault is actively comparing snapshot paths.
